api-gateway.description: Nginx-based API gateway, routes requests to backend services and enforces authentication

auth-service.description: Handles OAuth2 authentication, token issuance and validation via external OAuth provider

user-service.description: Handles user profile operations, depends on auth-service for token validation

order-service.description: Handles order creation and management, depends on auth-service for token validation

postgres.description: PostgreSQL database, shared by user-service and order-service

redis.description: Redis cache for session tokens and order data

external-oauth-provider.description: External OAuth2 provider (Google), auth-service connects via HTTPS
